title: Amazing Alhambra
text: Alexis was our driver to Grenada and back to Seville. He was full of historical facts that helped put into perspective what we would see in Grenada and the Alhambra. We loved the independence of walking through Granada and having a snack before our tour. Andy met us and we began a three hour journey through the amazing Alhambra! He was fabulous! I cannot say enough about this amazing tour!
author: Denise_S

title: Amazing tour! Amazing guide!
text: We decided to splurge for this tour (since it was a bucket list item), and didn’t regret it for a second. Enrique was an amazing guide who clearly loves the Alhambra and Granada, and shared that with us. We got to see the usual tourist spots, but also plenty of Enrique’s favorites, including a favorite lunch spot. What an amazing day we had, and so many great pictures to remember our visit. We can’t say enough superlatives about this tour!
author: luvikotwo

title: If you’re looking at...
text: If you’re looking at going to the Alhambra, definitely consider booking with Vandalia Tours and request Enrique. When he was not able to buy the tickets at our reserved time, he offered several alternatives including adding an extra experience at no additional charge. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. His command of the English language was exemplary and appreciated on our tour. Masterful storyteller with deep local expertise. Truly an outstanding tour guide!
author: Dyann_T

title: Highly recommend this tour
text: My husband and are are celebrating our 26th wedding anniversary.  The trip to Al Hambra is one I will never forget.  Alex our tour guide was amazing - his knowledge of history and excellent communication style made it so interesting on the very long drive there and back.  He also introduced us to Andy who expertly took us through all of the parts of the Al Hambra.  This was so worth the money and I would recommend this company and their tour guides highly.  Alex and Andy made it a very special memory for us!
author: laveenak2023

title: Wonderful tour of Alhambra
text: Wonderful experience, Enrique was an amazing guide, super helpful and a great driver too. The tour was very informative and he has a wide knowledge base of history, culture and religion - highly recommend this tour!
author: Chetna_K

title: Our private guide...
text: Our private guide experience to the Alhambra from Seville was excellent. Alexis was such a great communicator from start to finish. A prompt pickup at our Seville hotel was followed by a comfortable ride to Granada with Alexis sharing his expert knowledge of Spain’s history which provided a context for our visit to the Alhambra - thank you Alexis! Emilio was our guide at the Alhambra and he was outstanding - thank you so very much Emilio for sharing your expertise and passion for this historic treasure (he also takes fantastic photos!). Highly recommend this private tour.
author: Janice_H

title: Phenomenal
text:
Our Alhambra tour was one of the highlights of our trip to Spain. It was  absolutely stunning, and the itinerary was well planned, giving us enough time to appreciate the incredible history, architecture, and atmosphere of the place.
Our tour guide Luca was outstanding—knowledgeable, engaging, and genuinely passionate about the history of Grenada.. he  brought every site to life with fascinating stories and historical insights, making the experience far more meaningful.
author: Rinu_K

title: Exceptional!!
text:
Visiting the Alhambra with Enrique as our guide was an incredible experience we’d highly recommend. Not only was he patient and highly knowledgeable/educated, but had a beautiful demeanour. He was sensitive to our needs, ensured we were comfortable and delivered the finest balance between a highly engaging tour and allowing us to run at our own pace. We couldn’t have asked for a better tour guide! Unforgettable. 
George, Lydia and family
author: Lydia_C

title: Personal family tour of Alhambra.
text: We traveled In a very nice mini van with greatA/C! Enrique was our tour guide for the day and he was excellent.  Very knowledgeable and customized the tour to our needs. Highly recommend this experience.
author: Jim_C

title: A great private trip to the Alhambra
text: A great trip, our private tour of the Alhambra was a highlight. Communications and logistics with Vandalia was wonderful throughout. Enrique was an exceptional guide. We needed to adjust the tour because of accessibility issues and he was very thoughtful for the entire day.
